title: Specify actual CCP2 radio-capability encoding
description:
Scope: hardware-capability encoding in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/spec/02b-ccp-receiver-aware.md. Define bounded representations for supported profiles/channels, simultaneous RX resources, TX chains, half-duplex exclusions, passband placement and finite demodulator limits. Specify absent, unknown and unsupported capability behavior. Use independent resource examples for a single radio and a multiple-RX/one-TX gateway. No driver development, hardware qualification, throughput multiplier or radio purchase is in scope.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.

Decomposition review scope: Also own the exact directional RF-observation report contract, not hardware capabilities alone: observer/receiver/direction identity, physical channel and profile, units and numeric ranges, observation clock/age/coverage, unknown/stale representation, schedule/plan generation and authenticated ownership. Specify the bounded report field layout before wire freeze; do not invent a link-loss estimate from TX completion or CCA.
design: Describe actual resources rather than enumerated settings. Coordinate nonconflicting signaling work referenced by project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.74 without adopting its old adaptive-SF assumptions.
acceptance_criteria:
The capability record distinguishes tunability and scanning from simultaneous reception, and RX chains from TX chains. Worked encodings cover one-radio, restricted-passband, exhausted-demodulator and unknown-capability cases. Invalid or insufficient capabilities cannot establish eligible transmission or a capacity claim. Counts/lists have exact bounds and authenticated context references.

Additional required acceptance: Worked positive and rejection byte examples cover both hardware capability records and directional observation reports, with explicit units and identity/generation binding. This is the report-layout producer for Python/Rust/C signaling leaves.
notes:
